function.name: user_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a user based on the provided user name and the status of the mandates. This API is intended for use by partners to retrieve information about their clients' mandates. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

name.description: The full name of the partner's client for whom to fetch mandates.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If omitted, mandates of all statuses will be retrieved.

function.name: partner_mandates
function.description: Fetches the mandates associated with a partner based on the specified status. If no status is provided, all mandates are retrieved. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

status.description: The status of the mandates to be fetched. If left empty, mandates with any status will be retrieved.

message.content:
A **mandate** in the context of financial services (especially within the UK banking system) refers to an instruction or authorization given by a customer to a bank or payment service provider to execute a specific type of transaction on their behalf. Mandates are commonly used for recurring payments such as standing orders, Direct Debit instructions, or other scheduled transfers. Key points: | Feature | Description | |---------|-------------| | **Purpose** | Allows customers to set up regular, automated payments without needing to manually initiate each transfer. | | **Types** | • **Standing Order** – fixed amount, fixed frequency, usually to a non‑UK account.
• **Direct Debit** – variable amount, can be used for bills, subscriptions, etc. | | **Information stored** | • Customer’s name and account details
• Payee details (name, sort code, account number)
• Frequency (weekly, monthly, etc.)
• Amount (fixed or variable)
• Status (active, pending, inactive) | | **Status** | • **Active** – currently in effect and can be executed.
• **Pending** – awaiting confirmation or activation.
• **Inactive** – cancelled or expired. | Mandates are essential for automating payments, ensuring timely settlement, and reducing manual processing errors.
